steps.summary: Explore Moodle's forum capabilities for collaborative discussions, debates, and Q&A sessions.

steps.name: Introductions
steps.intro:
Section 1: Introductions

Get to know your classmates! Share a bit about yourself and your interests.

steps.name: Introduce Yourself
steps.intro: Welcome to the course! Please create a new post introducing yourself. Share your name, background, what you hope to learn, and one interesting fact about yourself. Then reply to at least two classmates' introductions.

steps.name: Topic Debate
steps.intro:
Section 2: Topic Debate

Engage in structured debate on a thought-provoking topic. Practice making evidence-based arguments.

steps.name: Debate: Technology in Education
steps.intro: Debate topic: Does technology improve or hinder learning in the classroom? Take a position (for or against) and support your argument with evidence and examples. Respond respectfully to opposing viewpoints. Guidelines: Start with a clear thesis statement, provide at least two supporting points, and engage with at least one counterargument.

steps.name: Q&A Session
steps.intro:
Section 3: Q&A Session

Ask questions and share answers with the class. This forum uses a Q&A format where you must post your own response before seeing others.

steps.name: Q&A: Course Topics Review
steps.intro: This is a Q&A forum. Post a question about any topic covered in the course, then answer at least one question posted by a classmate. You must submit your own answer before you can see other responses. This encourages independent thinking before collaborative learning.
